articles.headline: Reliance Reports 41% Profit Jump on Refining and Jio
articles.brief: Ambani-owned Reliance Industries has posted a remarkable 41% surge in profit, driven heavily by robust performance in its refining segment and sustained strength in its Jio telecommunications business.

articles.headline: France Vows Tough Response as Nation Braces for Unrest
articles.brief: The French government has promised a strict and unyielding response as the country prepares for potential fresh civil unrest, with security forces placed on high alert nationwide.

articles.headline: India Halts Sun Pharma Plant Production After Quality Lapses
articles.brief: Indian regulators have ordered Sun Pharma to immediately halt production of eye-care drugs at a dedicated manufacturing facility following severe regulatory quality lapses uncovered during inspections.

articles.headline: Six Dead in Himalayan State Helicopter Crash
articles.brief: Tragedy struck an Indian Himalayan state after a helicopter crashed, resulting in the deaths of six people on board, according to local reports from ANI.

articles.headline: Nasdaq Faces $2 Trillion Wipeout Amid Deepening AI Fears
articles.brief: The tech-heavy Nasdaq index is bracing for a staggering $2 trillion valuation loss in October as investor concerns intensify regarding massive, unyielding capital expenditures on artificial intelligence.

articles.headline: Cursor Confirms Users Affected by Tampered Claude Code Extension
articles.brief: AI code editor Cursor reported that up to 5,000 of its users were impacted by a compromised and tampered version of the Claude Code extension, prompting security alerts.

articles.headline: US Approves $2.1 Billion Patriot Missile Sale to Ukraine
articles.brief: The United States has officially approved a substantial $2.1 billion military sale supplying advanced Patriot missile defense systems to Ukraine to help repel ongoing aerial attacks.

articles.headline: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit Takes Over as Chief of Air Staff
articles.brief: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit has officially assumed command as the new Chief of Air Staff, taking over leadership of the Indian Air Force following the retirement of his predecessor.

articles.headline: Iran Supreme Leader Demands Unrestricted Response to Threats
articles.brief: Iran's supreme leadership has instructed military forces to prepare for an immediate, geographically unrestricted response against any aggressive moves by regional adversaries and Western powers.

articles.headline: Toyota Partners with Waymo to Launch Robotaxis in Japan
articles.brief: Toyota has joined forces with Waymo to manufacture autonomous electric vehicles equipped with cutting-edge self-driving technology, targeting a commercial robotaxi rollout in Japan by 2027.

articles.headline: Fitch Lowers France Credit Outlook to Negative on Debt
articles.brief: Rating agency Fitch has downgraded France's fiscal outlook to negative, warning that escalating debt-to-GDP ratios amid sluggish economic growth pose persistent budgetary and bond risks.

articles.headline: INDIA Bloc Moves Impeachment Motion Against CEC Gyanesh Kumar
articles.brief: Opposition parties under the INDIA bloc have formally introduced a public impeachment motion and charges against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, accusing the poll body of bias.

articles.headline: ISRO Successfully Launches GSLV-F18 with NVS-03 Satellite
articles.brief: The Indian Space Research Organisation has successfully launched the GSLV-F18 mission carrying the NVS-03 satellite, significantly strengthening India's indigenous NavIC satellite navigation network.

articles.headline: Noel Tata Seeks Board Review of Shapoorji Pallonji Exit Plan
articles.brief: In a major corporate governance shake-up at Tata Sons, Noel Tata has proposed strict board scrutiny regarding the SP Group's massive multi-billion-rupee share exit strategy.

articles.headline: Railways Mandate Overnight Power Socket Shutdown in Coaches
articles.brief: The Indian Railway Board has instructed all regional zones to automatically switch off coach charging socket points between 11 PM and 5 AM to prevent electrical hazards.
